name: Improved Curse of Lycanthropy (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Curse of lycanthropy, Ability Focus (curse of lycanthropy)

Benefit(s): The DC for the curse is equal to DC 10 +1/2 your Hit Dice + your Constitution modifier. You can also affect creatures of various sizes. If the victim is not within two size categories of you, your curse of lycanthropy has no effect.

Normal: Normally the curse can only affect victims within one size category of yourself.
